import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 2000010;
    static final long MOD_A = 1000000007L;
    static final long MOD_B = 998244353L;
    static final long BASE_NUM = 1000000L;
    static long total_count = 0;
    static long current_idx = 0;
    static long answer_sum = 0;
    static long[] prefix_sum_arr = new long[10];
    static List<Long>[] digit_buckets = new ArrayList[10];
    static long n;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            digit_buckets[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static long read_input(BufferedReader br) throws IOException {
        int sign = 1;
        long val = 0;
        int ch;
        while (true) {
            ch = br.read();
            if (ch == -1) break;
            if (ch == '-') {
                sign = -1;
                break;
            }
            if (Character.isDigit(ch)) {
                val = ch - '0';
                break;
            }
        }
        while (true) {
            ch = br.read();
            if (ch == -1 || !Character.isDigit(ch)) break;
            val = val * 10 + (ch - '0');
        }
        return sign * val;
    }

    static long mod_calc(long x) {
        long res = x % MOD_B;
        if (res < 0) res += MOD_B;
        return res;
    }

    static void build_sequence(long start, int depth) {
        total_count++;
        long val = mod_calc(total_count - start);
        digit_buckets[depth].add(val);
        answer_sum = (answer_sum + val) % MOD_A;
        if (depth == 6) return;
        for (int d = 0; d < 10; d++) {
            build_sequence(start * 10 + d, depth + 1);
        }
    }

    static void traverse_sequence(long num) {
        if (num > n) return;
        if (num * BASE_NUM + (BASE_NUM - 1) <= n && num * BASE_NUM * 10 > n) {
            long prev_idx = total_count;
            for (int level = 0, mult = 1; level <= 6; level++, mult *= 10) {
                int size = digit_buckets[level].size();
                long delta = mod_calc(prev_idx - num * mult);
                int pos = lowerBound(digit_buckets[level], MOD_B - delta);
                long sum_part = (delta * size) + prefix_sum_arr[level] - MOD_B * (size - pos);
                sum_part %= MOD_A;
                if (sum_part < 0) sum_part += MOD_A;
                answer_sum = (answer_sum + sum_part) % MOD_A;
                total_count += size;
            }
            return;
        }
        total_count++;
        long val = mod_calc(total_count - num);
        answer_sum = (answer_sum + val) % MOD_A;
        for (int d = 0; d < 10; d++) {
            traverse_sequence(num * 10 + d);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long target) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= target) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = read_input(br);
        build_sequence(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(digit_buckets[i]);
        }
        total_count = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            traverse_sequence(i);
        }
        System.out.println((answer_sum + MOD_A) % MOD_A);
    }
}
